method.method_draft: Inspect the lower-right intersection where the right steep line meets the lower slanted line. The diagram labels angle 12 in the upper-right region of that intersection and angle 15 in the lower-left region of the same intersection. From the text, read that m∠12 = 55. Since ∠12 and ∠15 are vertical angles, they are congruent, so m∠15 = 55.

method.method_draft: Inspect the lower-right intersection. Angle 12 is adjacent to angle 16 along the lower slanted line, so they form a linear pair. From the text, m∠12 = 55, hence m∠16 = 180 − 55 = 125. At the same intersection, ∠16 is adjacent to ∠15 along the right steep line, so ∠15 and ∠16 are also a linear pair. Therefore m∠15 = 180 − 125 = 55.
